facts.value: Entry uses f32 zero for initial frame and blend, f32 one for animation speed, and a double conversion bias to convert signed common x488 for comparison with fighter damage. The TU does not write these literals. This read usage does not imply nonwritable ELF flags or runtime memory protection.
facts.rationale: Existing object/report/assembly evidence shows a 16-byte mixed float/double pool and different source/split flags; see hashed section-evidence.json. Canonical signed x488 comparison establishes conversion use.

facts.value: Enters CliffEscapeQuick or CliffEscapeSlow according to fighter damage, initializes animation and common state, sets two flags and immediately runs cliff-catch physics. That helper positions the fighter relative to the held ledge when its ledge-validity test succeeds, and enters Fall when the test fails.
facts.rationale: Immediate cliff-catch physics has a Fall fallback when the ledge test fails; entry does not guarantee continued ledge attachment.
